Name: Shephatiah, Son of Jehoshaphat
Summary: Shephatiah was a son of Jehoshaphat who received great gifts from his father and was slain by his brother Jehoram.
KeyStory: Jehoshaphat's sons, including Shephatiah, were slain by Jehoram with the sword.
RelatedPeople: King Jehoshaphat; Jehoram, King of Judah
LifeLesson: The house of a faithful king was not spared a violent succession.
